# Thought Leadership Business School

> Thought Leadership Business School (TLBS) is an application-based education and advisory program for experienced professionals building authority through speaking, consulting, advisory, media, and intellectual property.

## About

TLBS helps six-figure professionals develop their positioning, signature methodology, premium offers, visibility, and systems for growing a thought leadership business. Its core methodology is the STORY Framework: Strategy, Thought Leadership, Offers & Monetization, Reach & Visibility, and Yield & Scale.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://thoughtleadershipbusinessschool.com/): Overview of TLBS and the STORY Framework.
- [Programs](https://thoughtleadershipbusinessschool.com/programs): Foundation, Accelerator, Mastermind, and Private Advisory pathways.
- [Free training](https://thoughtleadershipbusinessschool.com/free-training): The 7 Steps to Building a Seven-Figure Thought Leadership Brand.
- [TLBS Live](https://thoughtleadershipbusinessschool.com/live): Information about the in-person thought leadership experience.
- [Resources](https://thoughtleadershipbusinessschool.com/resources): Guides, worksheets, and other learning resources.
- [About](https://thoughtleadershipbusinessschool.com/about): About the school and its approach.
- [Success stories](https://thoughtleadershipbusinessschool.com/success-stories): Participant testimonials and reported outcomes.
- [Contact and applications](https://thoughtleadershipbusinessschool.com/contact): Application form and contact information.
